program: APPUI-01 - Windows 11 ARM64 Working App Visual Prototype
resolved_rules: Character-bounded work preserves the same Production and persistent Character identity while materially changing permitted disclosure.
Creator-only information is absent/inaccessible in bounded representation rather than merely dimmed, teased, counted or summarized.
Permitted current context and observable cues become primary inside the bounded view.
Entering bounded work does not duplicate, recast or replace the persistent Character.
Creator navigation, focus and selection remain interaction witnesses and never become Character action or fictional salience.
Only already-authorized action, speech or silence witnesses are reserved here as Character agency capacity; final performance input mechanics remain Product-defined.
Provider/model/cost, capability failure, diagnostics and recovery remain creator/application infrastructure and do not leak into Character perception by default.
Close/Back restores the prior creator semantic origin and focus when still valid; navigation is not Undo and transfers no hidden knowledge.

responsive_contract.wide: bounded task may remain primary with permitted adjacent context only when the active disclosure boundary allows it
responsive_contract.medium: bounded task remains primary while secondary permitted context overlays or substitutes
responsive_contract.narrow: sequential bounded task/detail/return surfaces preserve identity, disclosure, semantic origin and focus restoration

repairs: Removed the unapproved 'waiting' agency witness so the board stays within already-authorized action, speech and silence capacity.
Replaced the overly specific selection-versus-Character-attention wording with the broader authorized selection-versus-fictional-salience distinction.
Reran wide, medium, narrow and forced-colors checks after the semantic repairs.

non_authority: No final Presentation Perspective selector, entry/exit label, timing or confirmation semantics are frozen.
No final knowledge schema, inference policy or knowledge-transfer semantics are frozen.
No performance input grammar, Take a Seat command, performer/provider assignment or Stage visual successor is created.
No final typography, palette, icons, materials, motion, WinUI/runtime/package or Store authority is created.
conclusion: PASS: Character-bounded work materially changes disclosure while preserving Production identity, persistent Character identity, agency boundaries and exact creator-context return.
next_boundary: Detail empty, unavailable, loading and transitional workspace states inside the frozen Phase-1 shell without inventing Product-gated lifecycle or provider semantics.
